purpose: Teach: 東欧/山道/ナレーション/サーブ/スーツケース/露天風呂/ピント/節分

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、東欧、絶対、お料理、絶対、勉強したいの
lines.en: Sho, I really, truly want to study Eastern European cooking — I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, urgent energy. Leans forward slightly. Quick rhythmic pulses on each emphasis. Open, genuine enthusiasm without performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと、本気で、絶対、山道、絶対、ドライブ、絶対、行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I actually went on a mountain drive — really did it.
lines.style: Small, precise voice. Pride underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery with a quiet smile in it. Not seeking approval but sharing something real.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、テレビの、本気で、絶対、ナレーション、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、お声に似てるね
lines.en: You know, your voice sounds just like the narrators on TV — like your dad's voice.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. A moment of pause before speaking. Noticing something she's been thinking about. Warm without pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テニスの、本気で、絶対、サーブ、絶対、練習してるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been practicing my tennis serve — working at it.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Each word has weight even though delivery stays small. Little spark of pride at the edges. Not showing off, just reporting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、スーツケース、絶対、メイ姉さんの、絶対、貸してあげる
lines.en: Here, take my suitcase — I want you to have it for your trip.
lines.style: Generous, unhurried. Offering something that matters without making it dramatic. Warm and direct. The kind of care that doesn't need commentary.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんと、温泉の、本気で、絶対、露天風呂、絶対、入ったよ
lines.en: Dad and I went into the open-air bath at the hot spring — actually did it.
lines.style: Animated, present. Details matter to him. Small laugh underneath. Sharing something precious without overdoing it. Alive in the moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お写真の、本気で、絶対、ピント、絶対、合わせるの、絶対、難しいわよ
lines.en: Getting the focus right in photographs is harder than it looks, you know.
lines.style: Gentle, slightly self-aware. Honest about difficulty without complaining. Thoughtful pace. The tone of someone who's tried and learned something.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、節分、絶対、お豆まき、絶対、頑張ったよ
lines.en: I really went all out with the bean-throwing for Setsubun — gave it my best.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride. Quiet satisfaction. Not boasting but claiming the effort. Natural tempo, small smile at the edges of the voice.
